title: Stack
description: Flex layout primitives (Stack, HStack, VStack) with token-based gaps. Unlike Space, children are not wrapped in item elements.

basic.title: Vertical stack
basic.description: VStack stacks children in a column and stretches them by default.

horizontal.title: Horizontal stack
horizontal.description: HStack centers items on the cross axis; justify distributes them.

wrap.title: Wrap and semantics
wrap.description: wrap lets items flow onto new lines; as renders a list.

StackProps.gap: Gap between items: numbers and numeric strings select spacing tokens, other strings are CSS values. No gap when omitted.
